summary: Telecom Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) disclosing that Director Luca Luciani tendered his resignation for personal reasons, effective upon the shareholders' meeting that appoints his replacement. The Board will consider the resignation at its next meeting. No successor, transition timetable, strategic rationale, advisor recommendation, or consideration is disclosed. This is an ordinary board-member resignation subject to customary replacement mechanics, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure that itself constitutes the special-situation event; no deal or capital-structure implications arise.
